    SELECT language, MAX(resolution) AS max_res 
    FROM song 
    WHERE resolution > 500 
    GROUP BY language
) AS T1 
JOIN song AS T3 ON T1.language = T3.language AND T1.max_res = T3.resolution 
JOIN artist AS T2 ON T3.artist_name = T2.artist_name
GROUP BY T3.language, T2.artist_name
```

SELECT languages, artist_name 
FROM song 
WHERE resolution > 500 
GROUP BY languages, artist_name 
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM song 
    WHERE resolution > 500 
    GROUP BY languages 
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
```

```sql
SELECT T2.artist_name, T3.language
FROM (
    SELECT T1.language, MAX(T1.resolution) AS max_res
    FROM (
        SELECT languages, resolution, f_id, artist_name
        FROM song
        WHERE resolution > 500
    ) T1
    GROUP BY T1.language
) T2
JOIN song T3 ON T2.language = T3.languages AND T2.max_res = T3.resolution
JOIN artist T4 ON T3.artist_name = T4.artist_name
GROUP BY T2.language, T3.artist_name
```

FROM files AS T1 
JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.artist_name = T2.artist_name 
JOIN (SELECT languages, artist_name 
      FROM song 
      WHERE resolution > 500 
      GROUP BY artist_name, languages 
      HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM song 
        WHERE resolution > 500 AND artist_name = T2.artist_name 
        GROUP BY artist_name, languages 
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
      )) AS T3 ON T1.artist_name = T3.artist_name
GROUP BY T3.languages, T1.artist_name
